summary: Requirements cover summarize, the CLI, error reporting, parser immutability and injectable parser. They are atomic and testable with concrete acceptance values that I checked against parser.py (header skipping, zero-padded scores, line numbering). Assumptions are recorded; two minor gaps remain.

checklist.note: summarize, CLI, parser unchanged, injectable parser for unit tests all map to REQ-001..006.
Rounding half-up, key order, tie-break and exit codes are explicit.
Values verified: 1/3->0.3, 2.25->2.3, 07+100=107, 'line 3' for the missing-score line with header.
cp949-safe ASCII JSON, stdlib only, no parser change (REQ-004, REQ-006).
Performed, none found; no real conflicts apparent.
No security or data-loss decisions; exit code 2 extension is recorded as ASM-002.

findings.description: REQ-006 (parser not modified, parser injection, stdlib only) has no acceptance criteria; injection and unmodified parser should be verifiable (e.g. fake parser result drives summarize output, parser.py unchanged).

The parser accepts any str.isdigit() score, including non-ASCII digits such as superscripts, for which int() raises ValueError without a 'line N' prefix. Edge case not covered by REQ-005; consider stating behaviour.
